cues.text: A massive gas giant hangs in the starry blackness. Its swirling atmosphere is banded in broad strokes of teal, maroon, and pearlescent white. A small grey moon orbits to the left.
A colony ship streaks toward the planet from the lower left, riding a bright trail of light.
The tiny craft descends toward the turbulent clouds, plunging into the vast, gaseous expanse.

beats.note: A large gas giant planet with bands of teal, maroon, and white is visible against a starry sky. A small moon is to the left.
A bright streak of light, a colony ship, is visible moving towards the planet from the bottom left.
The colony ship gets closer to the planet's surface.
The ship descends into the atmosphere.
